text.style: font-size: 5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', 'Helvetica', sans-serif

g.text: known before trial t, axes denoised in the top 12 PCs, fitted on 40 mice and evaluated on the 10 test-fold mice. Blue = state (K = 3), red = choice, green = reward, grey = time.
